definition_zh: 日程表；计划表；时刻表；附表；安排；预定
definition_en: a plan that lists times and tasks, a printed timetable, an attached list in a document, or the act of arranging something for a particular time
core_image: 一张对折的小纸片，上面一格一格写着时间与要做的事。
scene: The project is behind schedule because the steel arrived a month late.
sceneCN: 这里 schedule 是「预定进度、时间计划」（第 7 个义项：进度上的时间点）；句意：由于钢材晚到一个月，项目进度落后于计划。场景要点：工地、堆放的钢梁、墙上贴的进度表、红色标记。

pos.zh: 日程表；计划表；时刻表；附表

senses.title: A written plan of times
senses.titleCN: 时间表：把时间写进格子
senses.definition: a plan that lists the times at which events, classes, or tasks will take place
senses.definitionCN: 列出事件、课程或任务发生时间的计划
senses.example: Her schedule is full until Thursday.
senses.exampleCN: 她的日程一直排到周四都是满的。
senses.why: The Latin word schedula was a small slip of paper. The first schedules were literally slips on which times were written, so the plan and the paper are the same object.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 schedula 就是一张小纸片。最早的 schedule 就是写着时间的纸条，因此“计划”和“纸片”原本是同一个东西。

senses.title: A list of planned tasks
senses.titleCN: 计划表：任务按顺序排好
senses.definition: a list showing the order in which a set of tasks or stages will be done
senses.definitionCN: 列出各项任务或阶段完成顺序的清单
senses.example: The construction schedule lists every stage from foundation to roof.
senses.exampleCN: 施工进度表列出了从地基到屋顶的每个阶段。
senses.why: Once times are written on the slip, the order of the lines becomes a plan. The paper is no longer a note but an order of work.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把时间写进纸条，一行行的顺序就变成了计划。这张纸不再只是备忘，而是工作的次序。

senses.title: To arrange a time for an event
senses.titleCN: 安排：给事件定一个时间
senses.definition: to arrange for an event, meeting, or appointment to happen at a particular time
senses.definitionCN: 安排事件、会议或约会在某一时间发生
senses.example: We scheduled the interview for Monday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 我们把面试安排在周一上午。
senses.why: To schedule is to write a new line on the slip. The verb turns the paper into an action: you place the event into a free slot.
senses.whyCN: schedule 作动词，就是在纸条上添一行。它把纸上的记录变成动作：你把事件放进一个空着的格子里。

senses.title: To place something in a planned series
senses.titleCN: 排定：放进更大的计划序列
senses.definition: to include something in an official plan or series, with a fixed future position
senses.definitionCN: 把某事纳入正式计划或序列，并给定未来的位置
senses.example: The new drug is scheduled for release in 2027.
senses.exampleCN: 这种新药计划于 2027 年上市。
senses.why: Here the slip is a long national or corporate plan rather than one day. Scheduling means finding the line where this item belongs.
senses.whyCN: 这里的纸条不是一天的日程，而是一份国家或公司的长期计划。排定就是找到这一项该占的那一行。

senses.title: A printed timetable
senses.titleCN: 时刻表：公开印出来的时间
senses.definition: a printed table of times at which buses, trains, or flights leave and arrive
senses.definitionCN: 印出来的公交、火车或航班到发时间表
senses.example: The bus schedule changes on public holidays.
senses.exampleCN: 公共假日期间公交时刻表会调整。
senses.why: The slip grows into a printed sheet for everyone. A timetable is the same list of times, but fixed by an authority and made public.
senses.whyCN: 小纸条长成了给所有人看的印刷表。时刻表仍是同一份时间清单，只是由官方固定并向公众发布。

senses.title: An attached list in a document
senses.titleCN: 附表：附在正文后的清单
senses.definition: a list attached to a legal document or contract, giving details such as prices, property, or equipment
senses.definitionCN: 附在法律文件或合同后的清单，列明价格、财产或设备等细节
senses.example: The schedule to the contract lists all the equipment.
senses.exampleCN: 合同附表列出了所有设备。
senses.why: The same physical image returns: a sheet attached to a main document. It is a schedule because it is a separate slip carrying a list.
senses.whyCN: 同一个实物意象又回来了：附在正文后面的一张纸。它叫 schedule，正因为它是一张单独承载清单的纸片。

senses.title: A position against the plan
senses.titleCN: 进度：相对于计划的位置
senses.definition: the planned point in time used as a standard, as in on schedule, behind schedule, or ahead of schedule
senses.definitionCN: 作为标准的计划时间点，用于 on schedule、behind schedule、ahead of schedule 等表达
senses.example: The bridge opened two months ahead of schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥提前两个月开通。
senses.why: When the plan is drawn as a line of times, real events can sit on it, before it, or after it. Schedule becomes the reference line itself.
senses.whyCN: 当计划被画成一条时间线，现实事件就可以落在线上、线前或线后。schedule 于是成了那条参照线本身。

senses.title: Allocation of slots in a system
senses.titleCN: 排程：把资源分到时间格
senses.definition: the process of assigning tasks, jobs, or vehicles to available time slots in a system
senses.definitionCN: 把任务、作业或车辆分配到系统中可用时间段的流程
senses.example: Job scheduling software assigns each task to a machine.
senses.exampleCN: 作业排程软件把每项任务分配给一台机器。
senses.why: Modern scheduling keeps the old grid but fills it with machines instead of appointments. The slip has become a table of resources.
senses.whyCN: 现代排程保留了旧的格子，只是把格子里的人事换成了机器。纸条变成了一张资源分配表。

intro.en: Schedule goes back through French to Latin schedula, a small slip of paper, and further to Greek skhedē, a leaf of papyrus. The word travelled from a physical sheet to the times written on it.
intro.cn: schedule 经由法语追溯到拉丁语 schedula“小纸片”，再往前是希腊语 skhedē“纸草的一页”。这个词从一张实物的纸，走到了纸上写的时间。

items.en: Skhedē meant a leaf or sheet of papyrus, the writing material itself. The diminutive skhedion named a small sheet.
items.cn: skhedē 指纸草的一页或一张，即书写材料本身；指小形式 skhedion 指小张的纸。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek word as scheda, also spelled schida, meaning a sheet of papyrus or a page. The two spellings explain the later variation in the European forms.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入希腊词作 scheda，也有 schida 的拼法，意为纸草的一张或一页。两种拼法解释了后来欧洲各语言形式的差异。

items.en: The diminutive schedula, a little slip of paper, is the form that passed into French and English. A slip is exactly the size of a short list of times.
items.cn: 指小形式 schedula 意为“小纸片”，正是进入法语和英语的形式。一张纸片的尺寸，恰好够写一份简短的时间清单。

items.en: Old French cedule and schedule meant a note, a label, or a short list. The -ch- spelling came with learned Latin influence.
items.cn: 古法语 cedule、schedule 意为便条、标签或短清单；带 -ch- 的拼写来自拉丁语的学术影响。

items.en: English adopted the word in the 14c. for a explanatory note or a list attached to a document. The legal appendix sense is one of the oldest.
items.cn: 英语 14 世纪借入这个词，指解释性便条或附在文件后的清单。“法律附表”是最早的义项之一。

items.en: Railways and factories in the 19c. made the timetable sense central. American pronunciation keeps the Greek-derived /sk-/ while British keeps the French-derived /ʃ-/.
items.cn: 19 世纪的铁路与工厂让“时刻表”义成为中心。美式读音保留了希腊来源的 /sk-/，英式读音保留法语来源的 /ʃ-/。

note.en: The first group is built from schedule itself; the second compares words that also organize time or tasks, each with a different shape.
note.cn: 第一组由 schedule 自身派生；第二组比较同样组织时间或任务的词，但各自形状不同。

entries.definition: arranged to happen at a fixed time. It describes the event, not the plan.
entries.definitionCN: 已安排在同一固定时间发生的。它描述事件，而不是计划。

entries.definition: a person who arranges times, or a program that allocates slots in a system.
entries.definitionCN: 安排时间的人，或在系统中分配时间段的程序。

entries.definition: to arrange a new time for something that was already planned.
entries.definitionCN: 为已安排的事重新定时间；改期。

entries.definition: not placed on a plan; happening without a fixed time.
entries.definitionCN: 未列入计划的；没有固定时间而发生的。

entries.definition: a table of times for classes, trains, or events. It is the most concrete partner of schedule and rarely means a personal plan.
entries.definitionCN: 课程、列车或活动的时间表。它是 schedule 最具体的伙伴，很少指个人计划。

entries.definition: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting. It lists topics rather than times.
entries.definitionCN: 会议上要讨论的议题清单。它列的是议题，不是时间。

entries.definition: a detailed plan of a journey, including places and times. It is a schedule for travel.
entries.definitionCN: 包括地点与时间的详细行程计划，是旅行用的 schedule。

entries.definition: a planned series of events or performances. It stresses the sequence, not the clock.
entries.definitionCN: 计划好的一系列事件或演出。它强调顺序，而不是钟点。

entries.definition: a list of people and the times they are on duty. It schedules people rather than tasks.
entries.definitionCN: 人员及其值班时间的名单。它排的是人，不是任务。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek skhedē 'papyrus sheet' to Latin scheda and the diminutive schedula 'small slip'. Family words schedule, scheduled, scheduler, reschedule.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 skhedē“纸草页”到拉丁语 scheda，再到指小形式 schedula“小纸片”。词族为 schedule、scheduled、scheduler、reschedule。

normal.en: Schedula is a small slip; a schedule is a slip with times on it.
normal.cn: schedula 是一张小纸片；schedule 就是写上了时间的小纸片。

normal.en: The legal schedule is a sheet attached to the contract, not a plan at all.
normal.cn: 法律上的 schedule 是附在合同后的那张纸，根本不是计划。

normal.en: On schedule means your work sits exactly on the line drawn by the plan.
normal.cn: on schedule 就是你的工作正好落在计划画出的那条线上。

normal.en: Reschedule is to rub out the old time and write a new one.
normal.cn: reschedule 就是擦掉旧时间、写上新的。

normal.en: The British say /ʃ/, the Americans say /sk/: two routes back to the same Greek sheet.
normal.cn: 英式读 /ʃ/，美式读 /sk/：两条路都回到同一张希腊纸页。

abstract.en: A schedule is a promise made to future time.
abstract.cn: 日程表，是向未来的时间做出的承诺。

abstract.en: What is scheduled can be late, but the paper never forgets.
abstract.cn: 计划中的事可以迟到，但那张纸不会忘记。

abstract.en: Civilization runs on small slips of paper agreeing about when to meet.
abstract.cn: 文明靠一张张小纸片约定何时相见而运转。

examples.en: The nurse checked the duty schedule taped to the ward door.
examples.cn: 护士查看了贴在病房门上的值班表。

examples.en: They scheduled the bridge inspection before the winter storms.
examples.cn: 他们把桥梁检查安排在冬季风暴之前。

examples.en: The ferry runs on schedule even in heavy fog.
examples.cn: 即使大雾弥漫，渡轮仍按时刻表运行。

dict_mnemonic.text: “时刻就”——把时刻就写在纸条上 → schedule 日程表、安排

root: 源自希腊语 skhedē“纸草的一页”，经拉丁语 scheda“一张纸”、指小形式 schedula“小纸片”、古法语进入英语；核心是“写着时间的纸片”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of schedule, all one object: a slip of paper carrying times, which becomes a plan, a published timetable, an attached list, and finally the act of writing a new time on it.
sensesIntro.cn: schedule 的八个义项都围绕同一个东西：一张写着时间的纸片。它可以是计划、公开的时刻表、附在文件后的清单，最后变成“把新时间写上去”的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small slip of paper with times written in its boxes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张小纸片，格子里写着时间。

branches.en: TIMES ON PAPER: a personal timetable and a printed bus schedule are the same grid, one private and one public.
branches.cn: 纸上的时间：个人日程与公交时刻表是同一张格子，一张私用，一张公用。

branches.en: LISTS AND ATTACHMENTS: a project schedule and a contract schedule are both lists written on a separate sheet.
branches.cn: 清单与附件：项目计划表与合同附表，都是写在单独一张纸上的清单。

branches.en: FIXING A TIME: the verb writes a new line, either for one event or for an item inside a larger plan.
branches.cn: 定下时间：动词是在纸上添一行，或为单个事件，或为更大计划中的一项。

branches.en: POSITION AGAINST THE PLAN: on, behind, and ahead of schedule measure where reality sits against the line of times.
branches.cn: 相对于计划的位置：on、behind、ahead of schedule 衡量现实落在这条时间线的哪里。

branches.en: ALLOCATING SLOTS: machines and jobs are placed into the same boxes that once held appointments.
branches.cn: 分配时间格：机器与作业被放进曾经写着约会的那些格子里。

intro.en: Schedule has no living prefix of its own. English builds its family with -ed, -er, -ing, re-, and un-, and with fixed phrases such as on schedule.
intro.cn: schedule 本身没有活的英语前缀。英语用 -ed、-er、-ing、re-、un- 以及 on schedule 这类固定短语来构造词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin chain is scheda 'a sheet', its variant scida, and the diminutive schedula 'a small slip'. Greek skhedē lies behind all three but is not a Latin form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语链条是 scheda“一张纸”、异体 scida，以及指小形式 schedula“小纸片”。希腊语 skhedē 在三者之后，但它不是拉丁语形式。

items.meaning: fixed to happen at a stated time
items.meaningCN: 定在某一时间的；按计划进行的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The scheduled opening was postponed twice.
items.exampleCN: 预定的开幕时间推迟了两次。

items.meaning: a person who arranges times, or a system that allocates slots
items.meaningCN: 安排时间的人；分配时间段的系统（-er 表示执行者）
items.example: The operating system scheduler gave the video process priority.
items.exampleCN: 操作系统调度程序给了视频进程优先权。

items.meaning: the activity of arranging when things will happen
items.meaningCN: 安排时间的活动；排程（-ing 构成动作名词）
items.example: Careful scheduling kept the lab running all night.
items.exampleCN: 精心的排程让实验室整夜运转。

items.meaning: to set a new time for something already planned
items.meaningCN: 重新安排；改期（re- 表示再次）
items.example: The airline rescheduled the flight for the next morning.
items.exampleCN: 航空公司把航班改到第二天早上。

items.meaning: not planned for a fixed time
items.meaningCN: 计划外的；未安排时间的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: An unscheduled stop delayed the train.
items.exampleCN: 一次计划外的停车让列车晚点。

items.meaning: to set an event to happen at a stated time
items.meaningCN: 把事件定在某一时间（for 标记时间点）
items.example: The hearing is scheduled for 9 a.m.
items.exampleCN: 听证会定在上午九点。

items.meaning: at the planned time, neither early nor late
items.meaningCN: 按计划；准时（既不早也不晚）
items.example: The first tunnel was finished on schedule.
items.exampleCN: 第一条隧道按计划完工。

items.meaning: later than the plan requires
items.meaningCN: 落后于计划；误期
items.example: Heavy rain put the harvest behind schedule.
items.exampleCN: 大雨使收割落后于计划。

items.meaning: earlier than the plan requires
items.meaningCN: 提前于计划
items.example: The crew finished the runway ahead of schedule.
items.exampleCN: 施工队提前完成了跑道。

items.meaning: an attached list of fixed charges or prices
items.meaningCN: 费率附表；价目清单（商业复合词）
items.example: The builder sent a schedule of rates with the estimate.
items.exampleCN: 建筑商随估价一起寄来了费率附表。

definition_en: a plan for achieving something, a secret plan, an organized system, or a diagram showing how parts are arranged
core_image: 一张先勾出轮廓的草图：看清形状，再按形状行事。
scene: The pension scheme was redesigned to cover part-time workers.
sceneCN: 这里 scheme 是「（福利）制度、方案」（第 3 个义项：成套的制度安排）；句意：养老金制度经过重新设计，以覆盖兼职员工。场景要点：养老金文件、表格、盖章条款、兼职员工的工牌。

senses.title: A plan for achieving something
senses.titleCN: 计划：先画轮廓再动手
senses.definition: a plan or set of steps for achieving a particular aim
senses.definitionCN: 为达到某一目标而制定的计划或步骤
senses.example: The scheme aims to cut traffic in the city centre.
senses.exampleCN: 该方案旨在减少市中心的交通流量。
senses.why: Greek skhēma is a shape or outline. A plan is the outline drawn before the building exists, so the word begins as a visible form rather than a promise.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 skhēma 是“形状、轮廓”。计划就是建筑还不存在时先画出的轮廓，因此这个词的起点是一个看得见的形状，而不是一句承诺。

senses.title: A secret or dishonest plan
senses.titleCN: 阴谋：藏在暗处的轮廓
senses.definition: a secret plan, especially one intended to gain an advantage dishonestly
senses.definitionCN: 秘密计划，尤指以不正当手段获取利益的计划
senses.example: The two managers were arrested for a scheme to hide losses.
senses.exampleCN: 两名经理因隐瞒亏损的阴谋被捕。
senses.why: The same outline is now hidden from view. A plan that others cannot see is felt as a plot, so the neutral shape takes on a shade of deceit.
senses.whyCN: 同样的轮廓现在被藏起来不让人看见。别人看不到的计划会被感受为阴谋，于是中性的“形状”带上了欺骗的色彩。

senses.title: An organized system of rules or benefits
senses.titleCN: 制度：把安排固定成体系
senses.definition: an organized system of rules, benefits, or arrangements, especially one run by an institution
senses.definitionCN: 由机构运作的有组织的规则、福利或安排体系
senses.example: The company runs a share-option scheme for its staff.
senses.exampleCN: 公司为员工实行股票期权制度。
senses.why: A large outline can hold many people and rules at once. When the shape is drawn by an institution and repeated, a plan becomes a scheme in the sense of a system.
senses.whyCN: 一张大的轮廓可以同时容纳许多人和规则。当这个形状由机构画出并被反复执行，计划就成了“体系”意义上的 scheme。

senses.title: A diagram or outline
senses.titleCN: 图解：形状本身被画出来
senses.definition: a diagram or simplified drawing that shows how the parts of something are arranged
senses.definitionCN: 展示某物各部分如何排列的图解或简化图
senses.example: The scheme on page 12 shows how the parts fit together.
senses.exampleCN: 第 12 页的图解展示了各部件如何组合。
senses.why: Here the word returns to its oldest layer: skhēma is literally a figure. The diagram is the plan made visible, with no time and no secrecy.
senses.whyCN: 这里词回到了最古老的一层：skhēma 本义就是“图形”。图解就是被画出来的计划，既没有时间，也没有秘密。

senses.title: To plot something secret
senses.titleCN: 密谋：把轮廓藏起来画
senses.definition: to make secret plans to gain an advantage, usually at someone else's expense
senses.definitionCN: 秘密策划以获取利益，通常损害他人
senses.example: They schemed to take over the rival firm.
senses.exampleCN: 他们密谋接管竞争对手的公司。
senses.why: The verb keeps the image of drawing a shape, but the drawing is done in private. Scheming is planning that cannot be shown to the people it affects.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了“画形状”的意象，但画是在私下进行的。scheming 就是不能给受影响者看的计划。

senses.title: To devise a plan
senses.titleCN: 构思：替复杂问题画出方案
senses.definition: to design or devise a plan, especially a complicated one for a practical problem
senses.definitionCN: 设计或构思方案，尤指针对实际问题的复杂方案
senses.example: Engineers schemed a new drainage system for the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师为山谷构思了一套新的排水系统。
senses.why: Without the secrecy, the verb simply means to draw the outline of a solution. This is the neutral technical use that survives in engineering and planning.
senses.whyCN: 去掉秘密色彩，动词就只是“为解决办法画出轮廓”。这是工程与规划中保留下来的中性技术用法。

senses.title: A pattern of rhymes or repetitions
senses.titleCN: 格式：诗句里重复的图形
senses.definition: the pattern in which rhymes or repeated elements are arranged in a poem or a design
senses.definitionCN: 诗歌或设计中押韵或重复元素的排列格式
senses.example: The poem's rhyme scheme is abab.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗的押韵格式是 abab。
senses.why: A rhyme scheme is a shape you can see on the page: lines repeating in a fixed figure. The diagram sense has become abstract, but it is still a pattern of positions.
senses.whyCN: 押韵格式是页面上看得见的形状：诗句按固定图形重复。图解的义项在这里变抽象了，但它仍然是位置构成的图案。

senses.title: A technical coding or classification system
senses.titleCN: 编码方案：给数据定一套形状
senses.definition: a standardized system for coding, classifying, or representing information
senses.definitionCN: 对信息进行编码、分类或表示的标准化体系
senses.example: The map uses a standard colour coding scheme.
senses.exampleCN: 这张地图采用标准的颜色编码方案。
senses.why: In computing and taxonomy, a scheme is a fixed framework into which data must fit. It is the institutional system sense applied to symbols rather than people.
senses.whyCN: 在计算机与分类学中，scheme 是数据必须装进去的固定框架。它是“制度体系”义用到符号上，而不是用在人身上。

intro.en: Scheme comes from Greek skhēma 'form, shape', a noun from the verb ekhein 'to hold, have'. Latin borrowed it as schema, and English took it through French with the senses 'figure of speech', then 'plan', then 'plot'.
intro.cn: scheme 来自希腊语 skhēma“形状、形式”，这是动词 ekhein“握住、拥有”的名词形式。拉丁语借作 schema，英语经法语借入，义项从“修辞格”走到“计划”，再到“阴谋”。

items.en: Ekhein meant 'to hold, have, keep'. A shape was understood as the way something is held together, its bearing or posture.
items.cn: ekhein 意为“握住、拥有、保持”。形状被理解为某物被“握持”的方式，即它的姿态与体态。

items.en: Skhēma meant form, shape, figure, and also the figure a speaker or dancer makes. It is the direct source of schema and scheme.
items.cn: skhēma 意为形式、形状、图形，也指演讲者或舞者摆出的姿态。它是 schema 与 scheme 的直接来源。

items.en: Latin schema was used for a figure of speech and for a logical figure. The rhetorical sense kept the word alive in learned writing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 schema 用于修辞格与逻辑图形。修辞学的用法让这个词在学术写作中存活下来。

items.en: Old French esqueme carried the rhetorical sense into English. The spelling scheme reflects the French form rather than the Latin schema.
items.cn: 古法语 esqueme 把修辞学义带进英语。拼写 scheme 反映的是法语形式，而不是拉丁语 schema。

items.en: In the 16c. scheme meant a figure of speech or a rhetorical device. The modern 'plan' sense is recorded from the 17c.
items.cn: 16 世纪 scheme 指修辞格或修辞手段。现代“计划”义从 17 世纪开始有记录。

items.en: The 'system' sense grew with administration and insurance, and the 'secret plot' sense with political writing. Both are extensions of a drawn outline.
items.cn: “体系”义随行政与保险业发展，“秘密阴谋”义随政治写作发展。两者都是“画出的轮廓”的延伸。

note.en: The first group is the direct learned family; the second separates plan, plot, diagram, and system, which scheme covers one by one.
note.cn: 第一组是直接派生与学术同族词；第二组区分 plan、plot、diagram、system，scheme 分别覆盖了它们的一面。

entries.definition: a structured framework or outline, used in psychology, logic, and databases. It keeps the Latin spelling and the abstract 'shape' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 结构化的框架或纲要，用于心理学、逻辑学与数据库。它保留拉丁拼写和抽象的“形状”义。

entries.definition: presented as a diagram or simplified outline. It describes the drawing, not the plan.
entries.definitionCN: 以图解或简化轮廓呈现的。它描述图画，而不是计划。

entries.definition: a person who makes secret or dishonest plans.
entries.definitionCN: 密谋者；阴谋家。

entries.definition: given to making secret plans; cunning.
entries.definitionCN: 工于心计的；诡计多端的。

entries.definition: a detailed proposal for doing something. It is the neutral word and carries no hint of deceit.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的详细提议。它最中性，不含欺骗意味。

entries.definition: a secret plan by several people to do something harmful. It is always negative, unlike scheme.
entries.definitionCN: 若干人秘密策划的害人计划。它总是贬义，而 scheme 不一定。

entries.definition: a plan or drawing showing how something will be made. It stresses arrangement and craftsmanship.
entries.definitionCN: 说明某物如何制作的计划或图样。它强调布局与工艺。

entries.definition: a set of connected rules or parts working together. It is broader and need not be drawn up by anyone.
entries.definitionCN: 相互连接的规则或部件组成的整体。它更宽泛，也不一定由谁制定。

entries.definition: a technical drawing or a detailed plan that others can follow. It keeps the physical image of a drawn scheme.
entries.definitionCN: 技术图样或他人可照做的详细计划。它保留了“画出的 scheme”这一实物意象。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek skhēma 'shape' from ekhein 'hold', Latin schema, French esqueme. Family words scheme, schema, schematic, schemer, scheming.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 skhēma“形状”来自 ekhein“握持”，拉丁语 schema，法语 esqueme。词族为 scheme、schema、schematic、schemer、scheming。

normal.en: Skhēma is a shape; a scheme is a shape drawn for action.
normal.cn: skhēma 是形状；scheme 是为行动画出的形状。

normal.en: Schema keeps the Latin spelling; scheme keeps the French one. Same Greek shape.
normal.cn: schema 保留拉丁拼写，scheme 保留法语拼写，都是同一个希腊“形状”。

normal.en: A pension scheme is a shape that holds thousands of people at once.
normal.cn: 养老金制度是一张同时装下成千上万人的形状。

normal.en: A rhyme scheme is a shape you can see in the layout of lines.
normal.cn: 押韵格式是能从诗句排列中看见的形状。

normal.en: When the outline is hidden from others, a scheme becomes a plot.
normal.cn: 当轮廓对别人藏起来时，scheme 就成了阴谋。

abstract.en: Every plan is a shape imposed on a future that has no shape yet.
abstract.cn: 每个计划，都是强加在尚无形状的未来之上的一种形状。

abstract.en: Schemes fail less often from bad aims than from shapes too rigid to bend.
abstract.cn: 方案失败，往往不是因为目标不好，而是因为形状太硬、弯不了。

abstract.en: The same outline can be a diagram, a policy, or a crime, depending on who may see it.
abstract.cn: 同一张轮廓，可以是图解、政策，也可以是罪行，取决于谁能看见它。

examples.en: The city approved a scheme to plant trees along every tram line.
examples.cn: 市政府批准了一项沿每条电车线路植树的方案。

examples.en: Investors lost millions in a scheme that promised impossible returns.
examples.cn: 投资者在一个承诺不可能收益的骗局中损失了数百万。

examples.en: The textbook opens with a scheme of the human digestive tract.
examples.cn: 这本教科书以一张人体消化道示意图开篇。

dict_mnemonic.text: “死机莫”——电脑死机前先把方案画成图 → scheme 计划、图解；谐音“试计谋”也可记阴谋义

root: 源自希腊语 skhēma“形状、图形”，来自 ekhein“握持”；经拉丁语 schema、古法语 esqueme 进入英语，核心是“先勾出形状的计划”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of scheme, all one gesture: drawing a shape before acting. The shape may be a plan, a hidden plot, an institution, a diagram, a rhyme pattern, or a coding frame.
sensesIntro.cn: scheme 的八个义项都来自同一个动作：动手之前先画形状。这个形状可以是计划、暗中的阴谋、制度、图解、押韵格式或编码框架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pencil sketch that outlines a shape before anything is built.
core.cn: 核心意象：动工之前，用铅笔勾出形状的草图。

branches.en: PLAN AND DEVISE: the noun and the neutral verb are the same outline, one already drawn and one being drawn.
branches.cn: 计划与构思：名词与中性动词是同一张轮廓，一张已画好，一张正在画。

branches.en: PLOT: when the outline is kept from the people it will affect, the same shape becomes deceit.
branches.cn: 阴谋：当轮廓对将受影响的人隐藏起来，同一形状就变成了欺骗。

branches.en: INSTITUTION: an outline repeated by an organization becomes a system of rules and benefits.
branches.cn: 制度：被组织反复执行的轮廓，变成一套规则与福利体系。

branches.en: VISIBLE PATTERN: a diagram and a rhyme scheme are shapes you can actually see on the page.
branches.cn: 可见图案：图解与押韵格式，都是页面上真能看见的形状。

branches.en: CODING FRAME: data must fit a fixed scheme, the institutional shape applied to symbols.
branches.cn: 编码框架：数据必须装进固定的 scheme，即制度形状用在符号上。

intro.en: Scheme's family is built on the Greek root for shape. English adds -atic, -er, -ing, and -ize, while schema keeps the Latin form unchanged.
intro.cn: scheme 的词族建立在希腊语“形状”词根上。英语加 -atic、-er、-ing、-ize；schema 则原样保留拉丁形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are schema and its genitive schematis, plus the Late Latin adjective schematicus. Greek skhēma stands behind them but is not a Latin entry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 schema 及其属格 schematis，还有晚期拉丁形容词 schematicus。希腊语 skhēma 在它们背后，但不是拉丁词条。

items.meaning: shown as a simplified diagram or outline
items.meaningCN: 以简化图解或轮廓表示的（-atic 构成形容词）
items.example: The manual includes a schematic view of the circuit.
items.exampleCN: 手册附有电路的示意图。

items.meaning: in the form of a simplified outline
items.meaningCN: 以简化图解的方式（-ally 构成副词）
items.example: The process is shown schematically in Figure 2.
items.exampleCN: 该流程在图 2 中以示意图形式呈现。

items.meaning: a person who makes secret plans
items.meaningCN: 密谋者；阴谋家（-er 表示做该动作的人）
items.example: The schemer behind the fake charity was finally caught.
items.exampleCN: 那个假慈善机构背后的阴谋家终于被抓。

items.meaning: making secret plans; cunning
items.meaningCN: 密谋的；工于心计的（-ing 构成分词与形容词）
items.example: Her scheming colleagues wanted her job.
items.exampleCN: 她那群工于心计的同事想要她的职位。

items.structure: Latin schema, from Greek skhēma (unchanged form)
items.meaning: a structured framework or outline
items.meaningCN: 图式；纲要；结构框架（保留拉丁形式）
items.example: Readers bring a schema of the genre to a new text.
items.exampleCN: 读者会把该文类的图式带进新文本。

items.meaning: to arrange something into a simplified system or diagram
items.meaningCN: 把某物整理成简化的体系或图解（-tize 构成动词）
items.example: The author schematizes a messy history into three stages.
items.exampleCN: 作者把纷乱的历史简化为三个阶段。

items.meaning: a planned combination of colours
items.meaningCN: 配色方案；有计划的色彩组合
items.example: The hotel uses a warm colour scheme.
items.exampleCN: 这家酒店采用暖色系配色。

items.meaning: an organized system for paying retirement income
items.meaningCN: 养老金制度；退休金计划（机构性复合词）
items.example: New staff are enrolled in the pension scheme automatically.
items.exampleCN: 新员工会自动加入养老金制度。

items.meaning: a planned outline of what will be taught over a term
items.meaningCN: 教学进度方案；学期工作计划
items.example: The teachers revised the scheme of work for the new syllabus.
items.exampleCN: 教师们为新教学大纲修订了教学进度方案。

items.meaning: the pattern of rhymes at the ends of lines
items.meaningCN: 押韵格式；韵脚排列方式
items.example: The sonnet follows an abba rhyme scheme.
items.exampleCN: 这首十四行诗采用 abba 押韵格式。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun borrowed from Greek skhēma
latinEntries.meaning: a figure, shape, or rhetorical figure
of a figure or shape; the stem used in compounds
latinEntries.meaningCN: 图形或形状的（属格形式，用于复合词）

latinEntries.meaning: belonging to a figure or outline
latinEntries.meaningCN: 属于图形或轮廓的（晚期拉丁形容词）

definition_en: to bring something to an end, to come to an end, to end a person's employment, or to stop at a fixed limit
core_image: 田野尽头立着一块界石：走到它，路就到此为止。
scene: The lease terminates at the end of March.
sceneCN: 这里 terminate 是「（合同）到期终止」（第 2 个义项：自行结束、期满）；句意：租约在三月底到期。场景要点：租约文件、翻到三月的日历、交回的钥匙、腾空的房间。

senses.title: Bring something to an end
senses.titleCN: 使终止：把进程推到界石前
senses.definition: to cause something such as a project, process, or agreement to end
senses.definitionCN: 使项目、进程或协议等结束
senses.example: The company terminated the project after the trial failed.
senses.exampleCN: 试验失败后，公司终止了这个项目。
senses.why: Latin terminus was a boundary stone. To terminate is to drive an activity up to that stone and stop it there, with someone doing the stopping.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 terminus 是界石。terminate 就是把一项活动推到那块石头前并停下，而且是由某人来停。

senses.title: Come to an end by itself
senses.titleCN: 自行结束：走到期限就到了
senses.definition: to end naturally at a fixed time, as a contract or period does
senses.definitionCN: 在固定时间自然结束，如合同或期限
senses.example: The contract terminates automatically after five years.
senses.exampleCN: 合同五年后自动终止。
senses.why: The same stone marks the limit, but now nobody pushes. The agreement reaches its boundary on its own, so the verb becomes intransitive.
senses.whyCN: 同一块界石标出界限，但这次没人推。协议自己走到边界，于是动词变成不及物用法。

senses.title: Dismiss someone from a job
senses.titleCN: 解雇：把人的任职期截断
senses.definition: to end a person's employment, especially as an official or euphemistic act
senses.definitionCN: 结束某人的雇佣关系，尤指以正式或委婉的说法
senses.example: He was terminated for repeated safety violations.
senses.exampleCN: 他因多次违反安全规定而被解雇。
senses.why: A job is a period with a boundary. Cutting it short means bringing that person's term to its limit before the natural date, so the word is used as a cold official euphemism.
senses.whyCN: 任职是一段有边界的时间。提前截断，就是把此人的任期在自然到期前推到界限，因此这个词被用作冷冰冰的官方委婉语。

senses.title: Of a route: end at a place
senses.titleCN: 到站：线路在界石处结束
senses.definition: of a bus, train, or line, to have a particular place as its final stop
senses.definitionCN: 指公交、火车或线路以某地为终点站
senses.example: The line terminates at a small station in the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 这条线路终止于山间的一个小站。
senses.why: Here the boundary is a real place on the ground. The rails stop where the terminus stands, and the word is entirely spatial again.
senses.whyCN: 这里的边界是地面上真实的地点。铁轨在终点站所在处停止，词义又完全回到了空间。

senses.title: To end a pregnancy
senses.titleCN: 终止妊娠：以医学术语截断
senses.definition: to end a pregnancy deliberately, used as a medical and legal euphemism
senses.definitionCN: 有意结束妊娠，用作医学与法律上的委婉说法
senses.example: The clinic offers counselling before a pregnancy is terminated.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所在终止妊娠前提供咨询。
senses.why: A pregnancy is treated as a process with a term. Ending it early is again stopping before the natural boundary, and the neutral Latin word keeps the statement clinical.
senses.whyCN: 妊娠被当作一段有期限的进程。提前结束，仍是在自然边界前停下；中性的拉丁词让表述保持临床语气。

senses.title: To end a process or connection
senses.titleCN: 终结进程：机器里的界石
senses.definition: of a program, process, or connection, to stop running or close
senses.definitionCN: 指程序、进程或连接停止运行或关闭
senses.example: The program terminates when the last window closes.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一个窗口关闭时，程序就终止。
senses.why: Software borrows the boundary stone for the point at which execution stops. The metaphor is exact: a process runs until it hits its end marker.
senses.whyCN: 软件借用了界石，指执行停止的那一点。这个比喻很精确：进程一直运行，直到撞上结束标记。

senses.title: To end in a particular result
senses.titleCN: 以……告终：终点处的结局
senses.definition: to have a particular result or conclusion, especially after a long process
senses.definitionCN: 尤指经过漫长过程后得到某种结果或结局
senses.example: The dispute terminated in a settlement.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争端以和解告终。
senses.why: When a path ends at a stone, what lies at the stone is the outcome. Terminate in names that outcome, turning a spatial end into a logical conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 当一条路终止于界石，石头所在处的东西就是结果。terminate in 指出的正是那个结果，把空间的终点变成逻辑的结论。

senses.title: To be bounded by something
senses.titleCN: 以……为界：边界贴着边界
senses.definition: to have a particular line, place, or feature as a boundary or ending point
senses.definitionCN: 以某条线、某个地点或特征为边界或终点
senses.example: The property terminates at the river bank.
senses.exampleCN: 这块地产以河岸为界。
senses.why: This is the oldest and most literal use: a piece of land stops where the boundary marker stands. Everything else in the word grows from this image.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老、最字面的用法：一块土地在界石所在处停止。这个词的其他义项都从这幅图像生长出来。

intro.en: Terminate comes from Latin terminus, the stone that marked a boundary, and terminare, to set a bound. English first used it as an adjective and later as a verb meaning to reach or set the limit.
intro.cn: terminate 来自拉丁语 terminus“标出边界的石头”和 terminare“设定边界”。英语先把它用作形容词，后来才用作“到达或设定界限”的动词。

items.en: Terminus was a boundary stone or marker between fields. It was also the name of the Roman god who protected boundaries.
items.cn: terminus 是田地之间标界的石头或标记，也是保护边界的罗马神祇之名。

items.en: Terminare meant to set a bound, limit, or end, and by extension to finish. The verb is built directly on the stone.
items.cn: terminare 意为设定边界、限度或终点，引申为完成。这个动词直接建立在“界石”之上。

items.en: The past participle terminatus meant bounded or finished. English kept it as an adjective before the verb became common.
items.cn: 过去分词 terminatus 意为“有边界的、已完成的”。在动词流行之前，英语先把它当作形容词使用。

items.en: Terminate appears in 15c. as an adjective meaning limited or bounded, and in the 16c. as a verb meaning to bring to an end.
items.cn: 15 世纪 terminate 作形容词，意为“有限的、有边界的”；16 世纪作动词，意为“使结束”。

items.en: Railways gave the word its familiar station sense: a line terminates where the track ends. The noun terminus carries the same stone.
items.cn: 铁路赋予这个词熟悉的站点义：线路在铁轨尽头终止。名词 terminus 承载着同一块界石。

items.en: The 20c. added the computing sense and made the employment sense a standard euphemism. The boundary image survives unchanged underneath.
items.cn: 20 世纪增加了计算机义，并使“解雇”义成为标准委婉语。底层的边界意象原封不动地保留着。

note.en: The first group shares the terminus root and its suffixes; the second separates the many ways an action can stop.
note.cn: 第一组共享 terminus 词根及其后缀；第二组区分“停止”这一动作的多种方式。

entries.definition: the act of ending something, or the end itself. It is also the formal word for dismissal.
entries.definitionCN: 结束某物的行为或结束本身；也是“解雇”的正式说法。

entries.definition: the end point of a journey or a device at the end of a line; as an adjective, at the end or fatal.
entries.definitionCN: 旅程的终点或线路末端的设备；作形容词指末端的、致命的。

entries.definition: able to be ended, especially of a contract with a fixed notice period.
entries.definitionCN: 可终止的，尤指附有固定通知期的合同。

entries.definition: seeming to have no end, usually because it is boring or long. The prefix denies the boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 似乎没有尽头的，通常因为冗长乏味。前缀否定了边界。

entries.definition: to stop or finish. It is the plain word and can be transitive or intransitive without any official tone.
entries.definitionCN: 停止或结束。它最普通，可及物也可不及物，没有官方语气。

entries.definition: to bring something to a deliberate close, such as a speech, deal, or investigation. It often implies a proper ending.
entries.definitionCN: 有意识地结束演讲、交易或调查，常含“圆满收尾”之意。

entries.definition: of a contract, licence, or period, to end because its time is up. It matches the intransitive sense of terminate.
entries.definitionCN: 指合同、执照或期限因时间到期而结束，对应 terminate 的不及物义。

entries.definition: to remove someone from a job or duty. It is the direct human word where terminate is the official euphemism.
entries.definitionCN: 解除某人的职务或工作。它是直接说人的词，而 terminate 是官方委婉语。

entries.definition: to stop happening or doing, often used of sounds, activities, or legal orders. It is more formal and less spatial.
entries.definitionCN: 停止发生或停止做，常用于声音、活动或法律命令。它更正式，空间感更弱。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Latin terminus 'boundary stone' and terminare 'set a bound'. Family words termination, terminal, terminus, terminable, interminable.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：拉丁语 terminus“界石”与 terminare“设定边界”。词族为 termination、terminal、terminus、terminable、interminable。

normal.en: Terminus is a stone in a field; terminate is stopping at that stone.
normal.cn: terminus 是田里的一块石头；terminate 就是在石头前停下。

normal.en: A terminal is where the rails meet the stone; a termination is where the contract does.
normal.cn: terminal 是铁轨遇到界石的地方；termination 是合同遇到界石的地方。

normal.en: Interminable denies the stone: a speech with no visible boundary.
normal.cn: interminable 否定了那块石头：一场看不到边界的演讲。

normal.en: Terminate at is a place on the ground; terminate in is a result at the end.
normal.cn: terminate at 是地面上的地点；terminate in 是终点处的结果。

normal.en: Being terminated is having your work period cut at the stone early.
normal.cn: 被 terminate，就是你的工作期限在石头前被提前截断。

abstract.en: Every ending is a boundary that someone agreed to call final.
abstract.cn: 每个结束，都是有人同意称之为最终的边界。

abstract.en: The stone does not stop the field; it only tells you where the field stops being yours.
abstract.cn: 石头并不让田野停止，它只是告诉你田野到哪里不再属于你。

abstract.en: We need termini not because roads are long, but because otherwise we never know when to stop walking.
abstract.cn: 我们需要终点，不是因为路长，而是否则永远不知道该在何时停下。

examples.en: The airline terminated the route after demand collapsed.
examples.cn: 需求骤降后，航空公司终止了这条航线。

examples.en: His contract terminated when the funding ran out.
examples.cn: 资金耗尽时，他的合同到期终止。

examples.en: The pipeline terminates at a storage tank near the coast.
examples.cn: 这条管道终止于海岸附近的一座储罐。

dict_mnemonic.text: “特迷你特”——特别迷你的特工走到田头界石就停下 → terminate 终止、到终点

root: 源自拉丁语 terminus“界石、边界标记”与 terminare“设定边界”；核心是“走到界石处为止”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of terminate, all one stone: an activity, a contract, a job, a route, a pregnancy, a process, or a dispute reaches its boundary and stops there.
sensesIntro.cn: terminate 的八个义项都围绕同一块界石：活动、合同、工作、线路、妊娠、进程或争端走到自己的边界，就在那里停止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boundary stone at the far edge of a field.
core.cn: 核心意象：田野尽头的一块界石。

branches.en: CUTTING AND ARRIVING: one party can push a thing to the stone, or the thing can reach it by itself.
branches.cn: 截断与抵达：一方可以把事情推到石头前，事情也可以自己走到那里。

branches.en: EMPLOYMENT: a job is a term with a boundary, and terminating cuts that term early.
branches.cn: 雇佣：工作是一段有边界的任期，terminate 就是提前截断这段任期。

branches.en: PLACES: a route and a property both stop at a real stone on the ground.
branches.cn: 地点：线路与地产都停在地面上真实的那块石头处。

branches.en: DELIBERATE STOPS: a pregnancy and a process are ended on purpose, one by medicine and one by code.
branches.cn: 有意停止：妊娠与进程都是被有意结束，一个靠医学，一个靠代码。

branches.en: OUTCOME: whatever lies at the stone when the path ends is the result it terminates in.
branches.cn: 结局：路走完时石头所在处的东西，就是它 terminate in 的结果。

intro.en: Terminate's family is built on Latin terminus. Suffixes make nouns of state and agents, -able marks what can be ended, and in- denies the boundary.
intro.cn: terminate 的词族建立在拉丁语 terminus 上。后缀构成状态名词与形容词，-able 表示“可被结束”，in- 否定边界。

latinIntro.en: The core Latin forms are terminus 'boundary stone', terminare 'to bound', and terminatus 'bounded'. Exterminare adds ex- 'out beyond'.
latinIntro.cn: 核心拉丁形式是 terminus“界石”、terminare“设界”、terminatus“有边界的”。exterminare 则加 ex-“向外越过”。

items.meaning: the act of ending something, or the end itself
items.meaningCN: 终止；结束；结束的行为（-ion 构成动作名词）
items.example: The termination of the lease requires sixty days' notice.
items.exampleCN: 终止租约需要提前六十天通知。

items.meaning: at the end of a line, or the end point itself
items.meaningCN: 末端的；终点站；终端（-al 构成形容词与名词）
items.example: We met at the bus terminal.
items.exampleCN: 我们在公交终点站见面。

items.meaning: in a way that ends, especially of a fatal illness
items.meaningCN: 在末端地；末期地，尤指致命疾病（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The patient was terminally ill.
items.exampleCN: 病人已处于绝症末期。

items.meaning: able to be ended, especially by notice
items.meaningCN: 可终止的，尤指可通过通知结束（-able 表示“可被”）
items.example: The agreement is terminable on six months' notice.
items.exampleCN: 该协议可在提前六个月通知后终止。

items.meaning: seeming to have no end
items.meaningCN: 无休止的；长得令人厌烦的（in- 否定“可终止”）
items.example: The meeting was interminable.
items.exampleCN: 那场会议漫长得没完没了。

items.meaning: to destroy completely, driving something beyond the boundary
items.meaningCN: 灭绝；彻底消灭（ex- 表示“向外、越过边界”）
items.example: The campaign aimed to exterminate the invasive beetle.
items.exampleCN: 这场行动旨在彻底消灭这种入侵甲虫。

items.meaning: the final stop of a route, or an end point
items.meaningCN: 终点站；终点（保留拉丁名词形式）
items.example: The terminus is a ten-minute walk from the market.
items.exampleCN: 终点站离市场步行十分钟。

items.meaning: to end at a stated place
items.meaningCN: 在某一地点终止（at 标记地点）
items.example: The cable terminates at the junction box.
items.exampleCN: 电缆在接线盒处终止。

items.meaning: to end with a particular result
items.meaningCN: 以某种结果告终（in 标记结果）
items.example: The march terminated in a peaceful rally.
items.exampleCN: 游行以一场和平集会告终。

items.meaning: to end by means of or with something
items.meaningCN: 以某物结束；以……收尾（with 标记结尾方式）
items.example: The ceremony terminated with a short prayer.
items.exampleCN: 仪式以一段简短的祈祷结束。

latinEntries.meaning: a boundary stone or marker; an end
to set a bound, limit, or end

latinEntries.meaningCN: 有边界的；有限的；已结束的

definition_en: a systematic explanation of facts, a body of ideas about a subject, the principles behind a practice, or an unproven speculation
core_image: 一群人坐在看台上远远观看一场演出：先看见，再试图解释。
scene: In theory, the bridge should hold twice its own weight.
sceneCN: 这里 theory 是「理论上、按推算」（第 6 个义项：抽象推算而非实际）；句意：理论上，这座桥应能承受自身重量的两倍。场景要点：图纸上的受力箭头、计算器、尚未建成的桥。

senses.title: A systematic scientific explanation
senses.titleCN: 科学理论：能解释事实的体系
senses.definition: a well-tested and widely accepted explanation of natural phenomena, supported by evidence
senses.definitionCN: 经充分检验、被广泛接受且有证据支持的自然现象解释
senses.example: The theory of plate tectonics explains why continents move.
senses.exampleCN: 板块构造理论解释了大陆为何移动。
senses.why: Greek theōria was a viewing, a act of watching. A scientific theory begins with careful observation, then builds the explanation that the watching supports.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 theōria 是“观看、观察”。科学理论从仔细观看开始，再建立观看所支持的说明。

senses.title: A body of ideas or doctrine
senses.titleCN: 学说：一个学派的一整套看法
senses.definition: a organized set of ideas or beliefs about a subject, often associated with a school or thinker
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题的有组织的一套观念或信念，常与某个学派或思想家相关
senses.example: He studied Marx's theory of history for his dissertation.
senses.exampleCN: 他为博士论文研究了马克思的历史学说。
senses.why: A single observation grows into a connected body of claims. The word then names the whole doctrine, not one explanation of one fact.
senses.whyCN: 单次观察长成一套相互关联的主张。这个词于是指整套学说，而不是对单一事实的解释。

senses.title: The principles behind a practice
senses.titleCN: 原理：一门技艺背后的道理
senses.definition: the general principles or rules underlying a practical art or skill
senses.definitionCN: 某一实践技艺背后的一般原理或规则
senses.example: She studied the theory of music before touching the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她在碰钢琴之前先学了乐理。
senses.why: Watching a practice from above yields its rules. Theory here is the map of a craft, separated from the hand that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 从高处观看一门实践，就得到它的规则。这里的 theory 是一门手艺的地图，与实际操作的双手分离。

senses.title: A hypothesis offered as explanation
senses.titleCN: 假设：尚未证实的解释
senses.definition: a proposed explanation that has not yet been proven or fully tested
senses.definitionCN: 尚未被证实或充分检验的提议性解释
senses.example: His theory is that the ship sank in a sudden storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他的假设是那艘船在突发的风暴中沉没。
senses.why: The same explanatory frame can be built before the evidence arrives. Then it is a hypothesis, but English still calls it a theory.
senses.whyCN: 同样的解释框架可以在证据到来之前先搭起来。这时它是假设，但英语仍称之为 theory。

senses.title: A speculative opinion
senses.titleCN: 推测：个人脑中的解释
senses.definition: an opinion or conjecture based on limited evidence, often in everyday talk
senses.definitionCN: 基于有限证据的看法或猜想，常用于日常谈话
senses.example: My theory is that the cat knocked the vase off the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我的推测是猫把花瓶从架子上碰了下来。
senses.why: In ordinary speech, watching becomes guessing. The word loses its scientific weight and names any attempt to explain what happened.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，观看变成了猜测。这个词失去科学分量，可以指任何对事情经过的解释尝试。

senses.title: In theory: as reasoned, not as practised
senses.titleCN: 理论上：推算成立，现实未必
senses.definition: used in the phrase in theory to mean according to reasoning or principle, as opposed to actual practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in theory，表示按推理或原理应当如此，与实际做法相对
senses.example: In theory, the system can process a million requests a second.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上，这个系统每秒能处理一百万次请求。
senses.why: Theory is what the spectator sees from the stand; practice is what happens on the field. The phrase sets the two viewpoints against each other.
senses.whyCN: theory 是看台上观众看到的，practice 是球场上实际发生的。这个短语把两个视角摆在对立面。

senses.title: Book learning as opposed to practice
senses.titleCN: 理论课：书本上的那一半
senses.definition: the part of a subject taught as principles and books rather than as hands-on practice
senses.definitionCN: 以原理和书本而非动手实践来教授的那部分内容
senses.example: The course balances theory with six hours of lab work.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把理论课与六小时实验课相平衡。
senses.why: In training, the viewing half and the doing half are separated. Theory class is where you watch and read before you are allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 在培训中，“观看”的一半和“动手”的一半被分开。理论课就是你被允许动手之前观看与阅读的地方。

senses.title: Idle or unrealistic speculation
senses.titleCN: 空论：脱离实际的高谈
senses.definition: speculation that is impractical or disconnected from reality, often used with a critical tone
senses.definitionCN: 不切实际或脱离现实的推测，常带批评语气
senses.example: That is pure theory; no one has tried it on a real farm.
senses.exampleCN: 那纯粹是纸上谈兵；没人在真实农场里试过。
senses.why: When the stand is too far from the field, watching never turns into doing. The word then carries the old complaint against pure contemplation.
senses.whyCN: 当看台离球场太远，观看就永远变不成行动。这个词于是带上了对纯粹空想的古老抱怨。

intro.en: Theory comes from Greek theōria 'a looking at, contemplation', built on thea 'a view' and the spectator word theōros. Latin and French carried it to English, where it shifted from watching to explaining.
intro.cn: theory 来自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与“观看者”theōros 构成。经拉丁语与法语进入英语，语义从“观看”转向“解释”。

items.en: Thea meant a view or a sight, the thing seen. It survives in English words such as theatre, where the view is what the audience comes for.
items.cn: thea 意为景象、所见之物。它保留在 theatre 等英语词中——观众来剧院，正是为了那个“景象”。

items.en: Theōros was a spectator, and also an envoy sent to consult an oracle or to watch a sacred festival. Watching was a public and often official act.
items.cn: theōros 是观看者，也是被派去求神谕或观看宗教节庆的使者。观看是一种公共的、常常带官方性质的行动。

items.en: Theōria meant a looking at, contemplation, and later a body of speculative knowledge. Philosophy used it for the highest kind of seeing.
items.cn: theōria 意为观看、沉思，后来指思辨性的知识体系。哲学用它表示最高层次的“看”。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria mainly in learned and theological writing. The word stayed close to contemplation rather than to practical skill.
items.cn: 拉丁语主要在学术与神学写作中借用 theoria。这个词始终贴近“沉思”，而不是实用技能。

items.en: French théorie reached English in the 16c. with the sense of a scheme of ideas, especially in mathematics and philosophy.
items.cn: 法语 théorie 于 16 世纪进入英语，义为观念体系，尤用于数学与哲学。

items.en: The scientific revolution fixed the modern sense: a tested explanation of evidence. The everyday sense of a guess is older and never disappeared.
items.cn: 科学革命固定了现代义：对证据的受检验解释。日常“猜测”义更古老，并且从未消失。

note.en: The first group is theory's own family; the second ranks explanation words by how much evidence they claim.
note.cn: 第一组是 theory 自身的词族；第二组按“声称有多少证据”排列各种“解释”词。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas and principles rather than practice. It describes the mode, not the claim.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎观念与原理而非实践的。它描述方式，而不是主张。

entries.definition: a person who develops or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 建立或研究理论的人；理论家。

entries.definition: to form theories or speculate about something.
entries.definitionCN: 建立理论；对某事进行推测。

entries.definition: a statement proven from axioms, not a general explanation. It shares the Greek root but is a different kind of claim.
entries.definitionCN: 由公理证明的命题，不是一般性解释。它共享希腊词根，但主张的类型不同。

entries.definition: a proposed explanation to be tested. It is explicitly provisional, where theory may be either tested or loose.
entries.definitionCN: 有待检验的提议性解释。它明确是暂定的，而 theory 可能是已验证的，也可能松散。

entries.definition: a body of beliefs taught by a church, party, or school. It stresses authority rather than evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 教会、政党或学派所传授的信念体系。它强调权威，而非证据。

entries.definition: a basic rule or truth that explains how something works. It is usually narrower than a theory.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物如何运作的基本规则或真理。它通常比 theory 窄。

entries.definition: guessing about something without firm evidence. It matches the everyday and critical senses of theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在没有确凿证据的情况下猜测。它对应 theory 的日常义与批评义。

entries.definition: an opinion formed from incomplete information. It is formal and openly admits the lack of proof.
entries.definitionCN: 根据不完整信息形成的看法。它较正式，并公开承认缺乏证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek thea 'view' and theōros 'spectator' give theōria 'a looking at'. Family words theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize, theorem.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成 theōria“观看”。词族为 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。

normal.en: The theatre and theory share thea: both are about a view.
normal.cn: theatre 与 theory 共享 thea：两者都与“看”有关。

normal.en: A theorist is a spectator who writes down what the game explains.
normal.cn: 理论家就是一位把比赛所说明的东西写下来的观众。

normal.en: In theory is the view from the stand; in practice is the play on the field.
normal.cn: in theory 是看台上的视角；in practice 是球场上的踢法。

normal.en: A theorem is proved; a theory is supported. Different strength of claim.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的；theory 是被支持的。主张的强度不同。

normal.en: My theory about the vase is just watching turned into guessing.
normal.cn: 我对花瓶事件的 theory，只是把“看见”变成了“猜测”。

abstract.en: Theory is the distance we put between seeing and acting, in order to see better.
abstract.cn: 理论，是我们在“看见”与“行动”之间拉开的距离，为了看得更清楚。

abstract.en: A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory but a belief.
abstract.cn: 不可能出错的理论不是理论，而是信念。

abstract.en: Every practice is watched by some theory, even when the practitioner denies it.
abstract.cn: 每种实践都被某种理论注视着，即使实践者否认这一点。

examples.en: Darwin's theory took decades to be accepted by biologists.
examples.cn: 达尔文的理论花了几十年才被生物学家接受。

examples.en: The theory of harmony is easier to learn with a keyboard nearby.
examples.cn: 手边有键盘时，和声学理论更容易学。

examples.en: In theory the vaccine is free, but clinics still charge an admin fee.
examples.cn: 理论上疫苗是免费的，但诊所仍收取管理费。

dict_mnemonic.text: “思理论”——坐在看台上边看边思，慢慢就成了理论 → theory 理论、学说

root: 源自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成；核心是“先看，再解释”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of theory, all one act of watching: from the spectator's view grows a tested explanation, a doctrine, a set of principles, a guess, a classroom subject, or empty speculation.
sensesIntro.cn: theory 的八个义项都源自同一个“观看”动作：从观看者的视角生长出受检验的解释、学说、原理、猜测、课堂科目，或空洞的思辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spectators in a stand, watching a game and trying to explain it.
core.cn: 核心意象：看台上的观众，看着一场比赛并试图解释它。

branches.en: EXPLANATION: the same frame is a tested theory when the evidence is in, and a hypothesis when it is not.
branches.cn: 解释：同一框架在证据齐备时是受检验的理论，证据未到时是假设。

branches.en: DOCTRINE: a named school turns one explanation into a whole body of teaching.
branches.cn: 学说：一个有名字的学派把单一解释变成整套教导。

branches.en: PRINCIPLES: the rules behind a craft, whether written in a book or taught in a theory class.
branches.cn: 原理：一门技艺背后的规则，无论写在书里还是在理论课上讲授。

branches.en: SPECULATION: everyday guessing and idle theorizing are watching that never reaches the field.
branches.cn: 推测：日常猜测与空洞空论，都是从未落到球场上的观看。

branches.en: IN THEORY: the stand's viewpoint set explicitly against the field's practice.
branches.cn: 理论上：把看台的视角明确摆到球场的实践对面。

intro.en: Theory's family is built on the Greek root for viewing. English adds -etical, -ist, -ize, and -em, while theorem keeps a distinct mathematical path.
intro.cn: theory 的词族建立在希腊语“观看”词根上。英语加 -etical、-ist、-ize、-em；theorem 则走出一条不同的数学路径。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are theoria 'contemplation', theorema 'a thing looked at, a theorem', and the Late Latin adjective theoricus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 theoria“沉思”、theorema“被观看之物、定理”，以及晚期拉丁形容词 theoricus。

items.meaning: based on ideas and principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 基于观念与原理而非实践的（-etical 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper is purely theoretical and offers no data.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文纯属理论，没有提供数据。

items.meaning: according to theory; in principle
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按原理（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Theoretically, the reaction should finish in an hour.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这个反应应在一小时内完成。

items.meaning: a person who develops or studies theories
items.meaningCN: 理论家（-ist 表示人）
items.example: Literary theorists disagree about the author's intention.
items.exampleCN: 文学理论家对作者意图的看法不一。

items.meaning: to form theories or speculate
items.meaningCN: 建立理论；推测（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They theorized about the cause of the collapse.
items.exampleCN: 他们对坍塌的原因进行了理论推测。

items.meaning: the act of building theories
items.meaningCN: 理论化；建立理论的过程（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The book mixes fieldwork with heavy theorization.
items.exampleCN: 这本书把田野调查与大量理论化混在一起。

items.meaning: a statement proven from axioms
items.meaningCN: 由公理证明的命题；定理
items.example: The theorem holds for every prime greater than two.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对每个大于二的素数都成立。

items.meaning: according to principle, not necessarily in fact
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按理说（未必符合事实）
items.example: In theory, the two systems can run together.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这两个系统可以同时运行。

items.meaning: the explanation of species change by natural selection
items.meaningCN: 进化论；以自然选择解释物种变化的理论
items.example: The theory of evolution rests on fossil and genetic evidence.
items.exampleCN: 进化论建立在化石与遗传学证据之上。

items.meaning: a lesson teaching principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 理论课；讲授原理而非实践的课程
items.example: Theory class meets on Monday; the lab is on Wednesday.
items.exampleCN: 理论课在周一，实验课在周三。

items.meaning: an explanation that claims a secret plot by powerful groups
items.meaningCN: 阴谋论；声称有权势集团秘密策划的解释
items.example: The rumour grew into a full conspiracy theory.
items.exampleCN: 这个传言发展成了完整的阴谋论。

latinEntries.meaning: a thing looked at, a proposition, a theorem

definition_en: by that means, by that act, or as a result of that
core_image: 一根绳子从“那件事”牵到“这个结果”：动作在前，结果在后。
scene: The city banned cars from the old quarter, thereby reducing air pollution by a third.
sceneCN: 这里 thereby 是「从而、由此」（第 2 个义项：表示结果）；句意：该市禁止汽车进入老城区，从而使空气污染减少了三分之一。场景要点：禁行标志、无车的石板街、监测屏上的空气质量数字。

pos.zh: 借此；由此；从而（正式书面语）

collocations.zh: 这背后还有一段故事（古语）

senses.title: By that means
senses.titleCN: 借此：用那件事作为手段
senses.definition: by means of that action, tool, or arrangement; used to name the instrument that produces a result
senses.definitionCN: 通过那一动作、工具或安排；用于指出产生结果的手段
senses.example: They lowered the price and thereby attracted new customers.
senses.exampleCN: 他们降低了价格，借此吸引了新客户。
senses.why: There is the old locative 'that', and by is the preposition of means. Put together, thereby points to the thing just mentioned as the instrument.
senses.whyCN: there 是古英语的方位指示“那”，by 是表示手段的介词。两者合起来，thereby 就把刚提到的那件事指为工具。

senses.title: As a result of that
senses.titleCN: 由此：结果顺着动作落下
senses.definition: as a consequence of that action or fact, often introducing a participle clause
senses.definitionCN: 作为那一动作或事实的后果，常引导分词从句
senses.example: The rule was simplified, thereby reducing errors.
senses.exampleCN: 规则被简化，从而减少了错误。
senses.why: The same rope now runs from cause to effect rather than from agent to tool. English uses thereby with -ing clauses to mark the result that follows.
senses.whyCN: 同一根绳子现在从原因牵到结果，而不是从行动者牵到工具。英语用 thereby 加分词从句来标记随后出现的结果。

senses.title: Consequently, by that reasoning
senses.titleCN: 因此：按那条推理走下去
senses.definition: therefore, or as a logical consequence of what has just been said
senses.definitionCN: 因此，或作为刚说内容在逻辑上的后果
senses.example: The two events coincided, and thereby seemed connected.
senses.exampleCN: 两件事同时发生，因此看起来似乎有关联。
senses.why: A means can also be a premise: if you accept that, you are led to this. Thereby then works as a formal connector of reasoning rather than of physical action.
senses.whyCN: 手段也可以是前提：接受那一点，就会被引到这里。这时的 thereby 是推理的形式连接词，而不是物理动作的连接。

senses.title: By doing that
senses.titleCN: 借那一动作：方式即手段
senses.definition: by performing that particular act, especially when the act and its effect are one gesture
senses.definitionCN: 通过做出那一特定行为，尤指行为与效果是同一个动作
senses.example: She resigned, thereby avoiding a formal dismissal.
senses.exampleCN: 她辞职了，借此避免了被正式解雇。
senses.why: Here the means is not a tool but an act. Resigning and avoiding dismissal are the same movement seen from two sides, and thereby joins them.
senses.whyCN: 这里的手段不是工具，而是一个行为。辞职与避免解雇是同一动作的两面，thereby 把两面接在一起。

senses.title: By that fact alone
senses.titleCN: 凭那个事实：资格由此而来
senses.definition: by virtue of that fact or status, especially in legal or formal statements of entitlement
senses.definitionCN: 凭借那一事实或身份，尤用于法律或正式的权利陈述
senses.example: A person born there is a citizen, and thereby entitled to a passport.
senses.exampleCN: 在那里出生的人即为公民，并由此有权获得护照。
senses.why: The instrument is now a fact rather than an action. A status carries its consequences automatically, and thereby marks that automatic carry.
senses.whyCN: 工具现在是一个事实，而不是一个动作。身份会自动带来后果，thereby 标记的正是这种自动携带。

senses.title: In that respect
senses.titleCN: 在这一点上：就那方面而言
senses.definition: in that respect or by that provision, used in legal and older formal prose
senses.definitionCN: 在那一点上，或依据那项条款，用于法律与较早的正式文体
senses.example: The clause is void, and thereby the whole contract fails.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款无效，就此而言整份合同失效。
senses.why: This is the limiting use: thereby does not name a cause but marks the respect in which a statement holds. It survives mainly in legal writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是限定用法：thereby 不指出原因，而标记一句话在哪个方面成立。它主要残留在法律写作中。

senses.title: By which (archaic relative use)
senses.titleCN: 借此（古关系副词用法）
senses.definition: by which, used in older English to introduce a relative clause about a means
senses.definitionCN: 凭借之，用于较早英语中引导关于手段的关系从句
senses.example: They built a channel thereby the water might reach the fields.
senses.exampleCN: 他们修了一条渠道，借此水可以到达田里。
senses.why: Before whereby became the standard relative form, thereby could do that work. The modern language has pushed this use to the edge of the grammar.
senses.whyCN: 在 whereby 成为标准关系形式之前，thereby 也能承担这个功能。现代英语已把这种用法推到语法的边缘。

senses.title: The academic result connector
senses.titleCN: 学术连接：分词前的结果标记
senses.definition: a formulaic connector in academic writing, typically followed by a participle to sum up a consequence
senses.definitionCN: 学术写作中的套式连接词，通常后接分词，概括某后果
senses.example: The samples were dried overnight, thereby preventing contamination.
senses.exampleCN: 样品被晾干过夜，从而防止了污染。
senses.why: Modern academic style fixed the pattern thereby + -ing. The old rope between act and result has become a punctuation mark of argument.
senses.whyCN: 现代学术文体固定了 thereby + -ing 的句式。那根连接动作与结果的旧绳子，变成了论证里的标点符号。

intro.en: Thereby is not a Latin word at all. It is an English compound of there, the old locative of 'that', and by, the preposition of means. The two were joined in Old and Middle English and later restricted to formal prose.
intro.cn: thereby 根本不是拉丁词，而是英语复合词：there 是“那”的古方位形式，by 是表示手段的介词。两者在古英语与中古英语中结合，后来被限制在正式书面语中。

items.en: Þǣr was the locative form of 'that', meaning 'there, in that place'. It is the ancestor of modern there and of the there- compounds.
items.cn: þǣr 是“那”的方位形式，意为“在那里”。它是现代 there 以及 there- 系列复合词的祖先。

items.en: Bī meant 'by, near, by means of'. It is the source of modern by and of the instrumental sense in thereby.
items.cn: bī 意为“在旁、靠近、凭借”。它是现代 by 的来源，也是 thereby 中手段义的来源。

items.en: A compound of the two is attested in Old English, though its frequency and exact range are uncertain. It already had the sense 'by that means'.
items.cn: 两者的复合形式在古英语中已有见，但其使用频率与确切范围存疑。它当时已含“借此、由此”之义。

items.en: Middle English therby carried the instrumental and result senses into general use. The spelling varied between ther-, thar-, and there-.
items.cn: 中古英语 therby 把手段义与结果义带入通用语。拼写在 ther-、thar-、there- 之间摇摆。

items.en: The modern spelling thereby settled in the 16c. As whereby and wherein took over the relative function, thereby narrowed to means and result.
items.cn: 现代拼写 thereby 在 16 世纪固定。随着 whereby、wherein 接管关系功能，thereby 缩小到手段与结果义。

items.en: Today thereby is almost exclusively formal and written. Its most frequent pattern is thereby + -ing, summarizing the consequence of the main clause.
items.cn: 今天 thereby 几乎只用于正式书面语。最常见句式是 thereby + -ing，概括主句的后果。

note.en: The first group is the there- compound family, which is easy to confuse; the second separates connectors that also join cause and result.
note.cn: 第一组是易混淆的 there- 复合词家族；第二组区分同样连接因果的连接词。

entries.definition: by which; it introduces a clause naming the means. It has taken over the relative job that thereby once did.
entries.definitionCN: 凭借之；引导说明手段的从句。它接管了 thereby 曾经承担的关系功能。

entries.definition: in that document, place, or matter. It points inside something already mentioned.
entries.definitionCN: 在其中；在该文件、地点或事情中。它指向前文已提到之物的内部。

entries.definition: for that reason; consequently. It marks inference, while thereby marks means or result.
entries.definitionCN: 因此；所以。它标记推理，而 thereby 标记手段或结果。

entries.definition: immediately after that; as a result of that. It marks sequence in time more than means.
entries.definitionCN: 随即；因此。它更多标记时间上的先后，而非手段。

entries.definition: in this way or as a result. It is the closest formal partner and can replace thereby in many result clauses.
entries.definitionCN: 以这种方式；因此。它是最接近的正式伙伴，在许多结果从句中可替换 thereby。

entries.definition: as a result; therefore. It is a full sentence connector and does not attach to a participle as thereby does.
entries.definitionCN: 结果是；因此。它是完整的句子连接词，不像 thereby 那样接分词。

entries.definition: in a way that fits what has just been said. It adds the idea of adjusting a response.
entries.definitionCN: 相应地；因此。它增加了“调整应对”的意思。

entries.definition: for this reason; from this fact. It is more logical and less instrumental than thereby.
entries.definitionCN: 因此；由此。它比 thereby 更偏逻辑，更少手段意味。

entries.definition: for that reason or in that way. It is the everyday connector that thereby replaces in formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 所以；这样一来。它是 thereby 在正式写作中替代的日常连接词。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: there 'that' + by 'by means of'. It is an English compound, not a Latin borrowing; the Latin entry list is empty by design.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：there“那”+ by“凭借”。它是英语复合词，不是拉丁借词，因此拉丁词条按实际情况留空。

normal.en: There + by: by that thing you just mentioned.
normal.cn: there + by：凭借你刚提到的那件事。

normal.en: Thereby reducing is the standard academic pattern: action first, result in the participle.
normal.cn: thereby reducing 是标准学术句式：先有动作，结果放在分词里。

normal.en: Whereby does the relative job; thereby does the means-and-result job.
normal.cn: whereby 干关系从句的活；thereby 干手段与结果的活。

normal.en: Thereby is not therefore: one names the instrument, the other names the inference.
normal.cn: thereby 不是 therefore：一个指出工具，一个指出推理。

normal.en: Thereby hangs a tale keeps the oldest flavour: by that fact there is a story.
normal.cn: thereby hangs a tale 保留了最古老的味道：由那件事，引出一段故事。

abstract.en: Thereby is grammar's way of tying an act to its shadow, the result.
abstract.cn: thereby 是语法把动作与它的影子——结果——绑在一起的方式。

abstract.en: A formal word for a simple thing: this, so that.
abstract.cn: 一个正式的词，说的却是极简单的事：这样，所以。

abstract.en: Every thereby hides a claim that the result really did follow.
abstract.cn: 每个 thereby 背后都藏着一个主张：结果确实随之而来。

examples.en: The firm automated its invoices, thereby cutting paperwork by half.
examples.cn: 公司实现了发票自动化，从而把文书工作减少了一半。

examples.en: He missed the deadline, thereby losing the deposit.
examples.cn: 他错过了截止日期，因此损失了定金。

examples.en: The two islands share a language and are thereby often treated as one region.
examples.cn: 这两座岛共享一种语言，因此常被当作一个地区。

dict_mnemonic.text: “得来拜”——得来全靠拜那一下，由此得结果 → thereby 借此、从而

root: 英语本土复合词：there“那”（古英语 þǣr 的方位形式）+ by“凭借、在旁”，合起来表示“借那件事、由此”。无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of thereby, all one rope: the thing just named is tied to its means, its act, its consequence, its inference, or the respect in which it holds.
sensesIntro.cn: thereby 的八个义项都围绕同一根绳子：把刚提到的事，系到它的手段、行为、后果、推理，或它成立的那个方面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope running from a named act to the result it drags behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根绳子从已被点名的事，牵到它拖在身后的结果。

chain: OLD ENGLISH BĪ = BY MEANS OF

branches.en: MEANS AND ACT: the instrument can be a tool or a deed, but in both cases it is what you use.
branches.cn: 手段与行为：工具可以是一件物，也可以是一个举动，但都是你所“用”的东西。

branches.en: RESULT: the rope runs forward into a consequence, most visibly in the academic thereby + -ing pattern.
branches.cn: 结果：绳子向前延伸到后果，最明显的就是学术体的 thereby + -ing 句式。

branches.en: INFERENCE AND ENTITLEMENT: from a premise or a status, something follows automatically.
branches.cn: 推理与资格：从一个前提或一种身份，某物自动随之而来。

branches.en: RESPECT: in legal prose the word can mark the aspect in which a statement holds.
branches.cn: 方面：在法律文体中，这个词可以标记一句话在哪个方面成立。

branches.en: RELATIVE USE: the archaic by which shows the compound doing a grammar job later taken by whereby.
branches.cn: 关系用法：古义的“凭借之”显示这个复合词曾承担后来由 whereby 接管的功能。

intro.en: Thereby has no derivational suffix. Its family is the there- compound set, built from there plus a preposition, and a few fixed academic patterns.
intro.cn: thereby 没有派生后缀。它的家族是 there- 复合词系列，由 there 加介词构成，另有若干固定的学术句式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source. Thereby is a native English compound of Old English þǣr and bī, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源。thereby 是古英语 þǣr 与 bī 构成的英语本土复合词，因此拉丁词条列表为空。

items.meaning: by that means or as a result of that
items.meaningCN: 借此；由此；从而（复合副词）
items.example: The ban cut traffic, thereby improving air quality.
items.exampleCN: 禁令减少了交通，从而改善了空气质量。

items.meaning: by which; introducing the means
items.meaningCN: 凭借之；据此（关系复合词）
items.example: They agreed a process whereby disputes go to arbitration.
items.exampleCN: 他们商定了一个程序，据此争端提交仲裁。

items.meaning: in that document or matter
items.meaningCN: 在其中；于此（复合副词）
items.example: The report and the tables therein are confidential.
items.exampleCN: 报告及其中表格均属机密。

items.meaning: to that document or matter
items.meaningCN: 对此；附之（复合副词）
items.example: The parties agreed to the terms and the annexes thereto.
items.exampleCN: 各方同意条款及所附附件。

items.meaning: immediately after that
items.meaningCN: 随即；因此（复合副词）
items.example: The vote passed; thereupon the meeting closed.
items.exampleCN: 表决通过，会议随即结束。

items.meaning: with that; thereupon
items.meaningCN: 以此；随即（复合副词）
items.example: He was satisfied therewith and signed.
items.exampleCN: 他对此满意并签了字。

items.meaning: the standard way of stating a result in academic prose
items.meaningCN: 学术写作中陈述结果的标准句式（thereby 后接现在分词）
items.example: The samples were sealed, thereby preventing evaporation.
items.exampleCN: 样品被密封，从而防止了蒸发。

items.meaning: a rarer pattern stating a consequence as a full clause
items.meaningCN: 较罕见的句式，用完整从句陈述后果
items.example: The treaty was signed, thereby the war ended.
items.exampleCN: 条约签署，战争由此结束。

items.meaning: there is a story attached to that fact
items.meaningCN: 这背后还有一段故事（固定文学短语）
items.example: He came by the map honestly; thereby hangs a tale.
items.exampleCN: 他得到那张地图来路正当；这背后还有一段故事。

items.meaning: thereby names the means, therefore names the inference
items.meaningCN: 对比用法：thereby 指手段，therefore 指推理
items.example: He lied, and therefore lost trust; he lied, thereby losing trust.
items.exampleCN: 他撒了谎，因此失去信任；他撒谎，从而失去了信任。

definition_en: the subject of a conversation, text, lesson, meeting, or argument
core_image: 地上被圈出的一个“地方”，大家把话都放进这个圈里。
scene: Climate migration was the main topic at the summit.
sceneCN: 这里 topic 是「议题、话题」（第 1 个义项：谈话的中心内容）；句意：气候移民是峰会上的主要议题。场景要点：会议桌、话筒、写有 Climate Migration 的桌牌、各国代表。

derivatives.zh: 当前热门的；局部的（用药）

senses.title: The subject of a conversation
senses.titleCN: 话题：谈话围住的那块地
senses.definition: the subject that people are talking or writing about at a particular moment
senses.definitionCN: 人们此刻正在谈论或书写的主题
senses.example: The weather is always a safe topic at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 餐桌上天气总是安全的话题。
senses.why: Greek topos meant a place. A topic is the place where the talk gathers: speakers circle it and put their words inside that circle.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 topos 意为“地方”。topic 就是谈话聚拢的那个地方：说话者围着它，把话放进圈内。

senses.title: The theme of a text or work
senses.titleCN: 主题：作品围绕的中心
senses.definition: the central subject or idea that a piece of writing, a film, or an artwork develops
senses.definitionCN: 文章、电影或艺术作品展开的中心题材或思想
senses.example: Loss is the main topic of the novel.
senses.exampleCN: 失去是这部小说的主题。
senses.why: When the circle is drawn by an author, the place becomes a theme. The text stays inside it for many pages, so topic names the ground the work stands on.
senses.whyCN: 当圈由作者画出，这块地方就成了主题。文本在圈内停留许多页，因此 topic 指作品立足的那块地。

senses.title: A question or title set for work
senses.titleCN: 题目：被指定的那块地
senses.definition: a subject set for an essay, examination, or discussion, often stated as a title
senses.definitionCN: 为作文、考试或讨论指定的主题，常以标题形式给出
senses.example: The exam asked students to write on one of four topics.
senses.exampleCN: 考试要求学生从四个题目中选一个写作。
senses.why: Here someone else draws the circle and hands it to you. The topic is the place you are required to stay in, which is why an essay can be off-topic.
senses.whyCN: 这里圈是别人画的，再交给你。topic 是你被要求待在里面那块地，因此作文会“离题”（off-topic）。

senses.title: An item on an agenda
senses.titleCN: 议题：会议桌上排好的一块
senses.definition: a subject listed for discussion at a meeting or conference
senses.definitionCN: 会议或大会上列入讨论的主题
senses.example: Budget reform is the third topic on the agenda.
senses.exampleCN: 预算改革是议程上的第三个议题。
senses.why: A meeting divides its time into places, and each item occupies one. The agenda is a map of those places, so each one is a topic.
senses.whyCN: 会议把时间分成若干“地方”，每个事项占一块。议程就是这些地方的地图，因此每一项都是一个 topic。

senses.title: A rhetorical commonplace
senses.titleCN: 论题：修辞学里存放论据的地方
senses.definition: a commonplace or stock argument in rhetoric, one of the topoi from which speeches were built
senses.definitionCN: 修辞学中的常见论题或固定论点，即演讲可据以展开的 topos
senses.example: The speaker reached for the topic of ancestral duty.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲者动用了祖先责任这一论题。
senses.why: In classical rhetoric, topoi were literally places in the memory where arguments were stored. A topic was a drawer you opened to find material.
senses.whyCN: 在古典修辞学中，topoi 字面上是记忆里存放论据的“地点”。topic 就是你打开取材料的抽屉。

senses.title: A subject area of study
senses.titleCN: 专题：学科里划出的一块领域
senses.definition: a subject or theme studied within a course, book, or field of research
senses.definitionCN: 课程、书籍或研究领域中学习的一个主题或题材
senses.example: The course covers topics from genetics to ecology.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课涵盖从遗传学到生态学的专题。
senses.why: A field of study is a large territory divided into smaller places. Each topic is one of those places, marked out for a lesson or a chapter.
senses.whyCN: 一个研究领域是一大片地域，被分成更小的地块。每个 topic 就是其中一块，为一课或一章划出来。

senses.title: The talk of the town
senses.titleCN: 谈资：所有人都在围的那块地
senses.definition: the subject that everyone is currently discussing, often with curiosity or gossip
senses.definitionCN: 当下所有人都在谈论的话题，常带好奇或八卦色彩
senses.example: The wedding became the topic of the whole village.
senses.exampleCN: 那场婚礼成了全村的话题。
senses.why: This is the conversation sense at full volume. The circle is now public and crowded, so topic means the place where everyone's attention has gathered.
senses.whyCN: 这是“谈话”义的满音量版本。圈现在是公开而拥挤的，topic 指所有人注意力聚集的那块地方。

senses.title: A local remedy (archaic)
senses.titleCN: 局部用药：涂在“那个地方”的药
senses.definition: a medicine applied to a particular part of the body, the original medical sense of topic and topical
senses.definitionCN: 涂敷于身体某一部位的药物，是 topic 与 topical 最早的医学义
senses.example: The physician prescribed a topic for the inflamed skin.
senses.exampleCN: 医生为发炎的皮肤开了局部用药。
senses.why: Medical Greek used topikos for 'of a place'. A topic remedy stays in one place on the body, so the word's oldest layer is simply locality.
senses.whyCN: 医学希腊语用 topikos 表示“属于某一地方的”。局部药只停留在身体的一个地方，因此这个词最古老的一层就是“地方性”。

intro.en: Topic comes from Greek topos 'place'. Aristotle's Topika were 'places' where arguments could be found, and English first used topic for such a commonplace before it came to mean any subject.
intro.cn: topic 来自希腊语 topos“地方”。亚里士多德的 Topika 是寻找论据的“地点”，英语最早用 topic 指这类常见论题，后来才泛指任何主题。

items.en: Topos meant place, region, or a position in an argument. The physical and rhetorical senses were never far apart.
items.cn: topos 意为地方、区域，也指论证中的一个位置。物理义与修辞义从未相距很远。

items.en: Ta Topika, the title of Aristotle's work on commonplaces, meant 'the places'. It listed the spots in memory from which arguments could be drawn.
items.cn: Ta Topika 是亚里士多德论常见论题著作的标题，意为“那些地方”。它列出记忆中可以取用论据的位置。

items.en: Latin topica was the name of the rhetorical work and of the commonplaces it described. Cicero wrote his own Topica on the same plan.
items.cn: 拉丁语 topica 既是这部修辞学著作的名称，也指它所描述的常见论题。西塞罗按同一思路写了自己的 Topica。

items.en: Topic entered English as a term of rhetoric, meaning a commonplace or a general head of argument.
items.cn: topic 作为修辞学术语进入英语，意为常见论题或论证的纲目。

items.en: From 'a place of argument' the word widened to 'a subject of discourse'. By the 18c. it could mean any matter under discussion.
items.cn: 从“论证的地点”扩大为“论述的主题”。到 18 世纪，它可以指任何正在讨论的事情。

items.en: Modern English added school and meeting uses: a set essay title and an agenda item. The medical adjective topical keeps the literal 'of a place' sense.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了学校与会议的用法：指定作文题与议程条目。医学形容词 topical 保留了字面的“属于某地”义。

note.en: The first group shares the Greek place root; the second separates subject words that differ in scope and setting.
note.cn: 第一组共享希腊语“地方”词根；第二组区分范围与场合不同的“主题”词。

entries.definition: of current interest, or applied to one part of the body. Two branches from the same 'place' root.
entries.definitionCN: 当前受关注的，或涂敷于身体局部的。同一“地方”词根的两个分支。

entries.definition: in a way that relates to current affairs, or applied to the skin.
entries.definitionCN: 就时事而言地；局部涂敷地。

entries.definition: a place name. It is topos 'place' plus onoma 'name'.
entries.definitionCN: 地名。由 topos“地方”加 onoma“名字”构成。

entries.definition: the physical description or mapping of a place. It is topos plus graphein 'write'.
entries.definitionCN: 对某地地貌的描述或测绘。由 topos 加 graphein“书写”构成。

entries.definition: the thing being discussed, studied, or represented. It is broader than topic and can name a whole field.
entries.definitionCN: 正在讨论、研究或表现的事物。它比 topic 宽，可指整个领域。

entries.definition: the central idea developed in a work or event. It is deeper than topic and often not stated directly.
entries.definitionCN: 作品或活动中展开的中心思想。它比 topic 深，且常不明说。

entries.definition: a matter that people disagree about and must decide. It adds conflict to the idea of a topic.
entries.definitionCN: 人们有分歧并须决定的事项。它在“话题”之上加了冲突。

entries.definition: a subject or situation being considered. It is the most neutral and often used in formal phrases.
entries.definitionCN: 正在考虑的主题或情况。它最中性，常用于正式短语。

entries.definition: a matter that needs an answer or decision. It is narrower than topic and points to a solution.
entries.definitionCN: 需要回答或决定的事项。它比 topic 窄，并指向答案。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek topos 'place', the title Topika, Latin topica. Family words topic, topical, topically, toponym, topography.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 topos“地方”、书名 Topika、拉丁语 topica。词族为 topic、topical、topically、toponym、topography。

normal.en: Topos is a place; a topic is the place where the conversation sits.
normal.cn: topos 是地方；topic 是谈话所在的那个地方。

normal.en: Aristotle's Topika were places in memory where arguments were stored.
normal.cn: 亚里士多德的 Topika，是记忆里存放论据的那些地方。

normal.en: Off-topic means you stepped outside the circle someone drew.
normal.cn: off-topic 就是你走出了别人画的那个圈。

normal.en: Topical cream stays in one place on the skin; a topical joke stays in one moment.
normal.cn: topical 药膏只停留在皮肤一处；topical 笑话只停留在一个时刻。

normal.en: Toponym and topography both keep topos: a name of a place, a writing of a place.
normal.cn: toponym 与 topography 都保留 topos：一个写地名，一个写地貌。

abstract.en: A topic is a place we agree to stand in together for a while.
abstract.cn: 话题，是我们同意一起站一会儿的那个地方。

abstract.en: Changing the topic is changing the ground under the conversation.
abstract.cn: 换话题，就是换掉谈话脚下的地面。

abstract.en: Every culture keeps its arguments in particular places; rhetoric is the map of those places.
abstract.cn: 每种文化都把论据存放在特定地方；修辞学就是这些地方的地图。

examples.en: The panel avoided the topic of pay until the last ten minutes.
examples.cn: 小组一直回避薪酬话题，直到最后十分钟才提起。

examples.en: Her essay wandered far from the topic set in class.
examples.cn: 她的文章远远偏离了课上指定的题目。

examples.en: Water rights are a sensitive topic in the region.
examples.cn: 水权在该地区是个敏感话题。

dict_mnemonic.text: “托匹克”——大家把话都托在这块小地方 → topic 话题、主题

root: 源自希腊语 topos“地方”，经亚里士多德《Topika》（论常见论题）、拉丁语 topica 进入英语；核心是“谈话与论证聚拢的那块地方”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of topic, all one place: talk, a text, an exam, a meeting, a rhetorical store, a field of study, public gossip, or a spot on the skin each mark out a circle where words or medicine stay.
sensesIntro.cn: topic 的八个义项都围绕同一块“地方”：谈话、文本、考试、会议、修辞论据库、研究领域、公众谈资或皮肤上的一点，都圈出一块让话语或药物停留的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle drawn on the ground, with all the words placed inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：在地上画一个圈，所有的话都放进圈里。

branches.en: TALK: a private conversation and public gossip are the same circle, one small and one crowded.
branches.cn: 谈话：私人对话与公众八卦是同一个圈，一个小，一个挤。

branches.en: TEXT AND FIELD: an author's theme and a course subject are places a work or a lesson stays inside.
branches.cn: 文本与领域：作者的主题与课程专题，都是作品或课程待在里面的一块地方。

branches.en: SET QUESTION: someone else draws the circle and requires you to stay in it.
branches.cn: 指定题目：别人画好圈，并要求你待在里面。

branches.en: AGENDA ITEM: a meeting divides its time into places, one per item.
branches.cn: 议程条目：会议把时间分成若干地方，每项占一块。

branches.en: THE LITERAL PLACE: a rhetorical topos is a storage place for arguments, and a topic remedy stays on one spot of skin.
branches.cn: 字面的地方：修辞 topos 是论据的存放处，局部药则停留在皮肤的一点上。

intro.en: Topic's family is built on Greek topos 'place'. English adds -ical and -ally, while compounds with -onym and -graphy keep the place root visible.
intro.cn: topic 的词族建立在希腊语 topos“地方”上。英语加 -ical、-ally；与 -onym、-graphy 构成的复合词让“地方”词根保持可见。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are topica 'the places of argument', topicus 'local or topical', and topographia 'description of a place'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 topica“论证的地点”、topicus“局部的、主题的”，以及 topographia“地方描述”。

items.meaning: of current interest, or applied to a part of the body
items.meaningCN: 当前热门的；局部外用的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The comedy is topical and refers to this week's news.
items.exampleCN: 这部喜剧紧贴时事，提到本周的新闻。

items.meaning: in relation to current affairs, or applied to the skin
items.meaningCN: 就时事而言地；局部涂敷地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The gel is applied topically twice a day.
items.exampleCN: 该凝胶每天局部涂抹两次。

items.meaning: a place name
items.meaningCN: 地名（topos“地方”+ -onym“名字”）
items.example: The toponym survives in old maps.
items.exampleCN: 这个地名保存在旧地图里。

items.meaning: the study of place names
items.meaningCN: 地名学（-y 构成学科名词）
items.example: Toponymy reveals who settled the valley.
items.exampleCN: 地名学揭示了谁曾定居在这个山谷。

items.meaning: the physical description or mapping of a place
items.meaningCN: 地形；地形描述或测绘（topos“地方”+ -graphy“书写”）
items.example: The topography makes road building expensive.
items.exampleCN: 这种地形使修路成本高昂。

items.meaning: relating to the physical features of a place
items.meaningCN: 地形上的（-ical 构成形容词）
items.example: A topographical map shows every ridge.
items.exampleCN: 地形图显示每一道山脊。

items.meaning: the sentence that states the main idea of a paragraph
items.meaningCN: 主题句；点明段落中心意思的句子
items.example: Put the topic sentence first for clarity.
items.exampleCN: 为清楚起见，把主题句放在开头。

items.meaning: a subject everyone is discussing now
items.meaningCN: 热门话题；当下人人讨论的主题
items.example: Heat pumps are a hot topic in construction.
items.exampleCN: 热泵是建筑行业的热门话题。

items.meaning: not related to the subject being discussed
items.meaningCN: 离题的；与讨论主题无关的
items.example: The moderator deleted several off-topic comments.
items.exampleCN: 主持人删除了几条离题评论。

items.meaning: the subject people are talking about
items.meaningCN: 谈话话题；人们正在谈论的主题
items.example: His resignation was the topic of conversation all week.
items.exampleCN: 他的辞职整周都是人们谈论的话题。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun from Greek ta Topika
latinEntries.meaning: the places of argument; rhetoric of commonplaces
latinEntries.meaningCN: 论证的地点；常见论题修辞学

latinEntries.structure: Late Latin adjective from Greek topikos
latinEntries.meaning: of a place; local; belonging to commonplaces
latinEntries.meaningCN: 属于某地的；局部的；属于常见论题的

latinEntries.structure: Greek topos + graphia, borrowed into Latin

definition_zh: 痕迹；踪迹；微量；追踪；追溯
definition_en: a mark left by something that has passed, a very small amount, or to follow marks, origins, or outlines
core_image: 泥地上留下一行浅浅脚印，指向某个已经离开的人。
scene: The police traced the call to a flat near the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 trace 是「追查、追踪来源」（第 4 个义项：追溯来源）；句意：警方追查到那通电话来自港口附近的一套公寓。场景要点：电话记录、地图上的一条线、港口、公寓门牌。

senses.title: A mark left behind
senses.titleCN: 痕迹：走过之后留下的印
